Hi all,

Uploading the candidate materials for AZ-132 (attached). Recruiting flagged this as a strong IC hire but there is some ambiguity around level (Senior vs. Staff) due to breadth on systems design vs. execution. Before we schedule, I want a short calibration so interviewers and the bar-raiser are aligned on:

- Role scope we want this hire to own (latency/throughput pipeline ownership vs. runtime compiler work).
- Leveling expectations for Senior vs. Staff (signal checklist + must-have/ nice-to-have).
- Interview focus per slot (system design, performance debugging, serving runtime, coding exercise).

Proposed 30-minute sync today at 11:00am PT. If that works, I'll loop in Sara (recruiter) and ask her to hold blocks. Agenda draft in the attached interview-slate-v3.xlsx; debrief-template.docx has the scoring rubric (we should keep weight for system design at 40%, debugging/runbook at 30%, culture/ownership 30%).

Please review attachments and reply with: 1) any must-ask questions you want on the deck, 2) who wants the bar-raiser role, 3) whether we push a Staff-level expectation for SLO ownership.

Thanks — Karthik

Karthik — thanks for the packet. Quick thoughts:

- I agree we should default to Senior unless the candidate demonstrates cross-team ownership and shipping infra-level projects (in which case Staff).
- Add a focused performance-debugging scenario (root cause a 2x latency regression) to the system design slot — that will help separate architects from implementers.
- I can be bar-raiser if needed; I think the debrief rubric should call out KV-cache/kv-cache-migration experience as a tiebreaker.

Agenda tweak: 10m role/leveling, 10m slot focus, 10m slots & logistics.

On the bar-raiser piece — if I take it I’d like the hiring committee to commit to post-hire mentoring time (we should note expectations in the offer).

Laura
